title: Your event pass
qr-explanation: Show this to an organiser for check-in, meals, merchandise and workshops. It works without a connection.
no-offline-pass: No event pass has been saved on this device. Open your participant profile online first.
pass-session-required: Your pass could not be recovered in this browser. Open it in the browser where you activated it, or ask an organiser for a new access code.
pass-recovery-failed: Your pass could not be loaded and no saved copy is available. Check your connection and try again.
sign-out-error: Could not sign out. Check your connection and try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.explanation: Choose how you receive event and food-service updates. If both channels are enabled, you will receive both.
notifications.discord-linked: Your verified Discord account is connected.
notifications.discord-unlinked: Verify through the Hack the Hill Discord bot before enabling direct messages.
notifications.status-unavailable: Discord link status is temporarily unavailable.
notifications.push-enabled: Push notifications are enabled on this device.
notifications.push-unavailable: Push is unavailable or blocked in this browser. Check your browser settings.
notifications.update-error: Could not update notification preferences. Please try again.
